items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1961-02-16
items.q: The interviewee is an early 20th-century jazz musician (Cie Frazier). The mention of 'Eminem' (a rapper born in 1972) is chronologically impossible for a personal relationship. The transcript appears to be a garbled or mis-transcribed oral history where 'Eminem' is likely a transcription error for a

ctx.x: In the band here. That's working with Howard's outfit now. Oh, yeah. You see? Then that band stood near Goodwild. Then another time we took that group and went and worked just like Eminem at the paddock. The paddock will use a band where the first thing she stopped, that's what Miss Valencia did at the paddock. She might be in there a couple of weeks or a month. She'd get rid of that group and then try to mix the men's up with another group to play the release, you know. Then some fellas won't play in there. No.…
